title: Move the RSI eval cluster to Susi Commercial Apps; forward susi tasks eval-corpus
goal: Vision: V-6. susi-gawd's eval/RSI cluster (eval_separation, cloud_rsi, rsi_corpus, experiment_lifecycle, eval_contamination, rsi_promotion, experiment_memory, scorecard, dev_canary, eval_receipt) is reached only from susi tasks eval-corpus. Commercial T-CORESIZEVAULT-8 (740e681f) serves susi-commercial tasks eval-corpus from core's current sources with identical stdout, stderr, exit codes and repository files on side-by-side fixtures. Forward the verb, delete the cluster and its tests (keeping the self-build contract test), re-point roadmap evidence, pin the ceiling (Mandate 84; CEO decision: moving to commercial is not loss).

reuse.searched: Destination: susi-commercial-apps susi-frontier-lab/src/rsi_eval carries core's current sources (commercial T-CORESIZEVAULT-8, 740e681f); forwarding reuses vault_exec's commercial executable lookup, generalised as run_commercial.

limitations: Without susi-commercial installed, susi tasks eval-corpus names that command and exits 1. Core alone also wrote SUSI_HOME config.json and error_metrics.jsonl through its own redaction seeding and error telemetry; the commercial run does not. The kept self-build contract test (VC-201-018) was already red on main before this change. Proven on Windows x86_64.
progress: Cluster deleted with its tests; eval-corpus forwards; forwarded and direct runs identical on 3 fixtures; 8 roadmap verdicts re-pointed; complete socket 298,400 -> 294,499 (-3,901), ceiling pinned.
